init_vit_weights: initialize Vision Transformer model weights using trunc_normal or JAX-style initialization
patchify_images: patchify a batch of images into flattened patch tokens for ViT input
generate_sincos_pos_embed: generate 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings for a given grid size and embedding dimension
window_partition_tokens: partition image tokens into non-overlapping windows with optional cyclic shift for Swin Transformer
flatten_with_shape: flatten a list of tensors and masks into a single batch while preserving shape metadata
